title: Pork Chops With Feta, Snap Peas, and Mint
description: Brawny and golden brown, these seared pork chops make a hearty one-pan dinner that’s rounded out by sweet sugar snap peas and loads of fresh mint. The feta, added at the end, melts into the pork and peas, spiking the sauce with its brininess. Be generous with the fresh lemon juice at the end; this rich dish gains a lot from the tang.
ingredients: 4 scallions, white and green parts, thinly sliced, plus more for serving
½ cup chopped fresh mint or basil, plus more for serving
directions: Season pork chops with salt and pepper. In a large skillet, heat oil over medium-high until shimmering.
Add the pork chops to skillet and sear, without moving, until dark golden, 3 to 5 minutes per side (depending on the thickness). Transfer to a plate.

Return the skillet to the stove and reduce heat to medium. Add butter to remaining oil in skillet, then add scallions and cook until lightly golden, 2 to 3 minutes. Add snap peas, most of the mint, red-pepper flakes, a pinch of salt, and a dash of water, broth, wine, or vermouth, stirring everything for 2 to 3 minutes to cook the veggies a little and coat everything fully with the pan juices.

Return pork chops to pan, surrounding them with snap peas (and optionally the cherry tomato halves). Cook over low heat until pork chops are just cooked through, 3 to 6 minutes longer (135 degrees minimum). Scatter feta over pork and snap peas.
Drizzle or squeeze lemon juice over the dish and sprinkle with more mint, scallions and black pepper before serving.
